lookahead_contract.metadata_revision_risk: arXiv title/abstract/version metadata may reflect revisions after the initial 2019 submission. Paper-level PIT work must pin the exact version and public-availability timestamp separately.
lookahead_contract.research_importance: UNASSESSED in Stage A. Citation counts, later journal outcomes, and later performance are not decision inputs.
lookahead_contract.selection_time_basis: Ex-post research triage using the canonical arXiv metadata snapshot observed at 2026-08-13T10:59:30Z. This is not a reconstruction of what was selectable in 2019.

selection_semantics.REJECT: Do not prioritize from metadata; malformed records fail closed.
selection_semantics.REVIEW: Potentially relevant, but metadata evidence is insufficient for automatic inspection priority.
selection_semantics.SELECT: Promote to paper-level inspection only. This is not an alpha, reproducibility, PIT, OOS, cost, or #claims approval.

year_specific_contract.paper_text_fields: Any field requiring full-paper inspection remains PAPER_TEXT_NOT_INSPECTED at Stage A. No public/proprietary data status, split boundary, benchmark definition, or code link is inferred.
